points.point: Ensure no damage of paint of panel and touch up if required
points.norm: Touch-up paint done on damaged paint area

points.point: Verification of Bolt tightening torque for bus bars & marking on it
points.norm: Bolt tightness should be as per applicable standard torque required & marking done

points.point: Ensure proper closing and alignment of all doors of panels
points.norm: All doors should be closing properly Equipment: Floor Mounted Panels
Should be free from any kind of Foreign Particles and Dust(Both Inside and Out side) Panel should be cleaned both inside/outside

points.point: Ensure no extra holes in gland plate and all cables are provided with gland or any other arrangement to keep the cable rigid
points.norm: Extra holes should be plugged
As per drawing / SLD / Specs.
should be free from any foreign particle Cable trench should be properly cleaned
